configuration.change: Finer catalogue-only young stellar structure and one global young RGB grade.

details.source: Gaia DR3 Young 1+2 plus MCPS U-selected faint hot stars
details.normalization: Each count field has unit integral. Adopted 80/20 Gaia/MCPS mixture, not fitted to regions. A single young RGB grade sets integrated light.
details.scale: Adopted 45 pc Gaussian sigma resolves stellar associations while suppressing individual-count speckle. Native grid cells are 19.53 pc. This is spatial regularization, not a measured disc thickness.
details.associations: All existing Bica finite 3D association groups and their amplitudes are retained, with no duplicate groups.
details.limits: Photometric CMD/Q selection is an age proxy. MCPS U systematics and crowding remain; the U band supplies selection only. One-arcsecond matching removes duplicates of the selected Gaia population.
